item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate executed successfully but validation HR@10 fell from 0.625 to 0.620, equivalent to one fewer hit among 200 users. Adding local filtering therefore showed no improvement in this seed-2024 run; the small difference does not establish why performance changed. The host selected epoch 25 of 45. Retain the 0.625 baseline as the stronger observed configuration.","code_summary":"Eight causal NextItNet residual blocks use dilation schedule [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8], depthwise temporal convolutions, and pointwise channel mixing. For dilation > 1, the first temporal stage averages parallel dilated and dilation-1 depthwise filters before mixing. Padding follows each convolution’s dilation, preserving causality and the 121-position maximum receptive field. Embeddings, normalization, GELU, dropout, masking, scoring interfaces, hyperparameters, and frozen host behavior remain unchanged."}
